# FLX-1007: two mapping keys collide after canonicalisation

**Family:** canonicalisation (the 1000 band)

NFC normalisation and key coercion (KERNEL-SPEC §2.1) can map two distinct source keys onto one canonical key -- for example True and 'true', or the composed and decomposed spellings of the same word. Merging them would silently drop a value, so the document is refused.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-1007
```
